svg.title: Figure 1 · The environments and conditions
svg.desc: Every environment and condition in the look library with its values
svg.text: 3 environments and 4 conditions with every value. A field the viewer never reads is struck through (environment.ground2).
Viewer reads: environment extent_m, grid, ground, sky; condition ambient, fog_m, sky_tint, sun (sim/scenes3d/viewer.js).

Generated by tools/figures/lookslib_readme.py from the look library, the scenes that use it and the viewer that reads it. Looks are picture only: a condition such as fog never changes a run (test_scenes3d.py).
